source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: A study of 156 cycles of preimplantation genetic diagnosis in couples with NF1 showed a lower proportion resulting in live birth than non-NF1 couples, but a rate comparable to couples with other autosomal dominant or X-linked disorders.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 116 Merker 2015 PMID 25557241. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 116
